events.event_name: Mary Kay Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared Pop-Up
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A one-day oversized beauty experience in Gansevoort Plaza tied to Mary Kay's Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared campaign, with product discovery, beauty touch-ups and interactive photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Current listings advertise free full-size Mary Kay makeup and skin-care products, beauty touch-ups and interactive experiences; giveaways are subject to availability.
events.caveats: Multiple current sources agree on Tuesday, September 15, 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza and describe the experience as free and open to the public. A separate event listing offers a free RSVP, but the public-access sources do not establish advance registration as mandatory, so this tracker does not label the event RSVP-required.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–7 PM. Free products are promotional giveaways and may run out; arriving earlier is safer.

events.what_it_is: A three-day immersive Cat Bodega celebrating NYC bodega cats, with cat-themed photo moments, games and a feline-sized bodega experience.
events.what_is_free: Free TEMPTATIONS cat-treat samples plus chances to win Cat Bodega-inspired merchandise through claw-machine and scratch-off activities.
events.caveats: Multiple current sources agree on September 17–19, noon–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery and describe the physical pop-up as free/open to the public. Treats and prize merchandise are promotional and subject to availability.
events.practical_notes: Thursday through Saturday, September 17–19, 12–6 PM each day. No advance RSVP requirement is published in the corroborating current listings.

events.event_name: Bobbi Brown The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 9th Ave between W 14th and W 15th St, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A Bobbi Brown beauty-newsstand takeover introducing Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ with sampling, a mirrored photo moment and morning-themed giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Current listings advertise a Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ sample, grapefruit Spindrift, a mini croissant and a scratch-off giveaway; select winners receive a full-size product.
events.caveats: Multiple current listings agree on Thursday, September 17, 12–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle. No ticket or approval requirement is published. Food, samples and prize items are promotional and may be supply-limited.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17 from 12–6 PM at the Chelsea Triangle newsstand area on Ninth Avenue between 14th and 15th Streets.

events.event_name: CookUnity The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Five locations: 873 Broadway; 266 W 23rd St; 369 Madison Ave; 275 W 4th St; 451 3rd Ave, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A one-day CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas, delis and corner stores where eight chefs serve complimentary CookUnity meals and hot bites.
events.what_is_free: A complimentary chef-made CookUnity dish for walk-in guests while supplies last, plus a bodega-style scratch-off ticket for chances to win additional CookUnity meals and dining experiences.
events.caveats: Multiple current sources agree on Thursday, September 17 from 11:30 AM–2:30 PM and describe the giveaway as open to walk-ins. Meals are explicitly while supplies last. Participating locations are Bari Bodega (873 Broadway), Madison Square Deli & Convenience (266 W 23rd St), New York Pizza and Cafe (369 Madison Ave), Sam's Deli (275 W 4th St), and Slice N' Spice Deli & Grill (451 3rd Ave).
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM at five Manhattan locations. Lines are expected and food is while supplies last, so arrive before or near the start time.
